summary: The note covers the 1911 World Allround Speed Skating Championships, in which defending champion Nikolay Strunnikov retained his title. He finished with the lowest number of points awarded, won all four distances, and became World champion again.
one_line: Nikolay Strunnikov retained his World Allround Speed Skating title at the 1911 championships by winning all four distances.
key_facts: The event was the 1911 World Allround Speed Skating Championships.
Nikolay Strunnikov was the defending champion at the 1911 World Allround Speed Skating Championships.
Nikolay Strunnikov prolonged his title at the 1911 championships.
Nikolay Strunnikov had the lowest number of points awarded at the 1911 championships.
Nikolay Strunnikov won all four distances at the 1911 World Allround Speed Skating Championships.
Nikolay Strunnikov became World champion at the 1911 World Allround Speed Skating Championships.
